resources.string: No app\'s security policy is broken
IMD turns the settings on again
Android will not let any normal app change these settings. The permission is granted once from a shell and survives reboots — but not a reinstall.
You first need to configure which settings to hide for this app in IMD → All apps → long press on app name → Settings template → select which settings to hide.
Keeping this app up to date
As this app is completely offline, please use Obtainium to check for updates and install them directly from GitHub releases.
You don\'t need to keep developer options enabled for Shizuku, so you can leave them switched off. Shizuku itself enables USB debugging on its own when attempting to start service.
No Shizuku service found. Start Shizuku, then try again.
Shizuku refused. Allow this app in Shizuku and try again — if you picked “deny and don\'t ask again”, clear it from Shizuku\'s app list first.
Shizuku could not run the command. Use the ADB command instead.

Disclaimer: Shizuku is only needed for this one grant. The permission survives reboots, so afterwards you can stop or uninstall Shizuku - unless you want to hide Display over other apps permissions also, which uses Shizuku service every time.
You can also disable debugging and developer settings if you enabled those to setup Shizuku, this app needs neither after successful setup.
With a PC: enable USB debugging → connect phone to a PC running ADB shell terminal → run the above command.

Without a PC (Recommended):
1. Install and setup Shizuku app, start Shizuku service
2. Click on the above Use Shizuku button
3. Click on allow when prompt shows.

Every time settings are applied, an ongoing notification appears with a Revert action. That notification is how you put your device back. You can disable all notifications for this app later if you choose to use quick setting toggles or home screen shortcuts to revert settings.
Already refused twice? Android stops showing the prompt — use Open settings instead.
1. Now simply launch your problematic apps by clicking on them in IMD.
1. Long press app icons to create homescreen shortcuts
3. Add Hide settings quick settings toggle
(tip: long pressing toggle opens Settings manager)
1. Use Settings manager app icon in your app drawer
2. Add Settings manager quick settings toggle
4. The setup is now complete but you are recommended to checkout:
2. Auto hide settings (IMD+, needs background service)
3. All other settings for deeper customisation
Select accessibility services to hide / manage
Select Display over other apps to hide / manage
You can change this later in Settings under User interface.
Both steps are required. The app cannot change or restore a single setting without them.
